rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for being or doing something outside rather than indoors.

example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 sik6 faan6 zo6 ceot1 min6

rows.note: Use this for movement to the outside, especially in sentences such as “I am going outside.”

example.english: I'm going outside to buy something.
example.jyutping: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 ceot1 heoi3 maai5 je5

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an outer surface or the space beyond a boundary.

example.english: The outside of this shirt is dirty.
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 saam1 ngoi6 min6 wu1 zou1 zo2

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose locative construction for being physically outside A.

example.english: Wait for me outside the house.
example.jyutping: hai2 gaan1 uk1 ceot1 min6 dang2 ngo5 laa1

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for a physical outer side or for something coming from outside a group, as in 外面嘅資料.

example.english: This is outside information, not an internal company document.
example.traditional: 呢啲係外面嘅資料，唔係公司內部文件。
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 hai6 ngoi6 min6 ge3 zi1 liu6 m4 hai6 gung1 si1 noi6 bou6 man4 gin6

rows.note: Use this colloquial choice when “outside” means the place beyond a building, room, or other boundary.

example.jyutping: nei5 hai2 ceot1 min6 dang2 ngo5 laa1

rows.note: Use this for something originating beyond the boundary, especially an external influence, object, or condition.

example.english: This illness may be caused by an outside infection.
example.traditional: 呢種病可能係外來感染引起嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 zung2 beng6 ho2 nang4 hai6 ngoi6 loi4 gam2 jim5 jan5 hei2 ge3

rows.note: Use this for being beyond a named territory, boundary, scope, or limit rather than physically outside a building.

example.english: I haven't been to any places outside Hong Kong.
example.traditional: 香港以外嘅地方，我一個都未去過。
example.jyutping: hoeng1 gong2 ji5 ngoi6 ge3 dei6 fong1 ngo5 jat1 go3 dou1 mei6 heoi3 gwo3

rows.note: Use this when excluding A or meaning “apart from A.”

example.english: Outside of Ah Ming, everyone else has arrived.
example.traditional: 除咗阿明之外，其他人都到齊喇。
example.jyutping: ceoi4 zo2 aa3 ming4 zi1 ngoi6 kei4 taa1 jan4 dou1 dou3 cai4 laa3

rows.note: Use this specifically for someone’s or something’s outward appearance rather than its physical exterior space or surface.

example.english: His outside appearance seems cold, but he is actually very kind.
example.traditional: 佢外表睇落好冷漠，其實係好好人。
example.jyutping: keoi5 ngoi6 biu2 tai2 lok6 hou2 laang5 mok6 kei4 sat6 hai6 hou2 hou2 jan4

rows.note: Use this for the outside world or people outside an organization, especially in expressions such as 外界消息.

example.english: The outside world reacted strongly to this news.
example.traditional: 外界對呢單新聞反應好大。
example.jyutping: ngoi6 gaai3 deoi3 ni1 daan1 san1 man4 faan2 jing3 hou2 daai6

rows.note: Use this before a number when an outside estimate means the maximum possible amount.

example.english: The outside limit for this job is three days.
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 gung1 zeoi3 do1 zou6 saam1 jat6
